[[Grulhammer Silverfist]] is a [[Polymock]] opponent found in [[Umbral Grotto]]. He's one of the fifth-tier opponents the player has to defeat in the Polymock quest chain.

As part of the Polymock quest chain, he uses the following forms (in order):
*[[Dredge Form]]
*[[Dolyak Rider Form]]
*[[Dwarven Arcanist Form]]

In tournament play, he selects from these forms:
*Common:
**[[Mergoyle Form]]
**[[Fire Imp Form]]
**[[Ice Imp Form]]
*Uncommon:
**[[Dwarven Arcanist Form]]
**[[Dredge Form]]
*Rare:
**[[Dolyak Rider Form]]

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Umbral Grotto}}
*[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Polymock Glacier}} (when challenged to Polymock match)

'''Quests involved in:'''

==Dialogue==
{{dialogue needed}}
Before being defeated:
:''"Who wants to lose at a game of Polymock? Step right up and get your backside handed to you! Hold back your tears long enough to marvel at my one-of-a-kind pieces. Guaranteed to brighten your day!"''
::'''I wish to play you {{sic}} in a game of Polymock.'''
::(before registering at least 3 pieces)
::''... to be added ...''
::(after registering at least 3 pieces)
::''"You will be removed from your party and taken to a Polymock arena to battle Grulhammer Silverfist. Do you wish to proceed?"''

:::'''Decline''': ''"No."''

:''"These Asura have been teaching me the tournament rules of their little Polymock game. It sounds intriguing. What do you say we play that way? You'll need 1 common piece, 1 uncommon piece, and 1 rare piece to play."''
::'''I wish to play you {{sic}} in a game of Polymock.'''
::(before registering 1 piece of each type)
::''"You don't have at least 1 common, 1 uncommon, and 1 rare Polymock piece unlocked yet. You cannot play any opponents using tournament rules at this time."''
::(after registering 1 piece of each type)
::''"You will be removed from your party and taken to a Polymock arena to battle Grulhammer Silverfist. Do you wish to proceed?"''
:::'''Accept''': ''"Yes."''
:::'''Decline''': ''"No."''

==Quotes==
During a Polymock match:
:''"Careful. You don't want to lose another piece."''
:''"I saw that coming before you even thought about it."''
:''"Oooh. That was too bad...for you."''
:''"You call that strategy?"''
:''"You just made another blunder. Think first, then act."''
:''"You might want to rethink that move."''
:''"You want to put some salve on that?"''
:''"You're doin' pretty well...considerin' you're playin' me!"''

When he loses a Polymock match:
:''"Damnation! Your constant yammerin' put me off me game. I should try that."''

When he wins a Polymock match:
:''"You've heard that practice makes perfect, right? Well, that  might not work for you."''

==Notes==
*Awards 90 [[Asuran reputation point]]s upon defeat in tournament play.
*The word "damn" in his defeat conversation line is censored if chat filtering is on.
